verdict.rationale: The OpenAI Agents SDK is operated through code (Runner.run(), FunctionTool, Python primitives). Nothing in the evidence shows that the SDK itself can be driven by natural-language commands. Agents built with it accept natural-language input, but that is a developer building block for constructing such a capability, not the product being operated in natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
